headline: Stevens goes unbeaten through MACF play
dek: Stevens finished conference play without dropping a point, turning a slow non-conference start into an eleven-win season across all matches. Stevens scored 37 goals and conceded 26 while taking six losses and three draws overall, finishing ahead of Misericordia atop the standings.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the conference splits into a dense upper tier and a steep drop below it: Misericordia's 41 goals outpace the combined totals of Delaware Valley, DeSales, and King's (Pa.).

wire.line: King's (Pa.) managed just five goals across all matches while conceding 35, finishing winless in conference play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three matches past their scheduled dates with no published result involve FDU - Florham.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Misericordia spread its attack across at least sixteen different goal scorers over the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lebanon Valley forward Abrielle Miller produced twelve goals and eight assists from 96 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Misericordia defender Kaleigh Horos scored ten goals and added three assists on 62 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: FDU - Florham goalkeeper Italia Penevolpe stopped 86 shots and allowed seventeen goals for a 0.835 save percentage.

last_match.line: The defeat ended a winning streak that carried Stevens unbeaten through conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
